responsibility: Coordinates the Rust frontend privacy checking pass for a crate. Its entry point builds the privacy-analysis pipeline in order—resolving each HIR item's effective ModuleVisibility, validating pub(restricted) declarations, traversing the crate to diagnose private-item uses, and then running the reachability visitor over visible items using type-check context and global mappings/resolution state—so this file is the top-level driver that sequences the privacy subsystem rather than implementing any one check itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the privacy-check driver: unlike rust-privacy-check.h, it actually sequences the privacy passes by constructing and invoking VisibilityResolver, PubRestrictedVisitor, PrivacyReporter, and ReachabilityVisitor over the crate.
